tokens.name: surface-screen-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the screen ground gradient.

tokens.name: surface-screen
tokens.usage: Screen ground where a flat colour is needed (middle of the gradient).

tokens.name: surface-screen-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom of the screen ground gradient.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Panel fill: a dark inset well, set into the screen ground.

tokens.name: surface-row-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the raised gradient on rows, tiles and buttons.

tokens.name: surface-row
tokens.usage: Raised fill where a flat colour is needed.

tokens.name: surface-row-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom of the raised gradient on rows, tiles and buttons.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.usage: Track of bars, cells and tanks: the darkest surface.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: 1px outline of panels, rows, tiles, buttons, bars. The game's own value; under 3:1 on its grounds, so it never carries meaning alone.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: 2px tank outline. Holds 3:1 on the raised surfaces.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Names, values, labels, on every surface.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Second reading in a row, on surface-panel and the raised surfaces.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Units, column headings, panel titles, on every surface.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orange. Outlines only: the header banner, the primary button, the selected control. Never a fill, never a status.

tokens.name: brand-hi
tokens.usage: Top of the blue gradient: header banner and primary button.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Blue where a flat colour is needed.

tokens.name: brand-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom of the blue gradient.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on the blue gradient.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, charging, in range. Lights, bar and cell fills, and text on surface-panel and the raised surfaces.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Out of range but not dangerous. Lights, chips, fills, and a value's colour.

tokens.name: status-crit
tokens.usage: Dangerous or empty. Lights, chips, fills, and a value's colour (24px and up on the raised surfaces).

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Off, vacuum, no data. Lights and chips.

tokens.name: on-status
tokens.usage: Chip label on any status fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Top of the destructive button gradient (lockdown, purge). Not a status colour.

tokens.name: danger-lo
tokens.usage: Bottom of the destructive button gradient.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill.

tokens.name: gas-outline
tokens.usage: Stand-in gas badge outline. In game the game's own icon is used.

tokens.name: on-gas-light
tokens.usage: Stand-in badge symbol on light badges: O2, N2O, X.

tokens.name: on-gas-dark
tokens.usage: Stand-in badge symbol on dark badges: N2, CO2, H2, CH4, O3.

tokens.name: gas-o2
tokens.usage: Oxygen tank fill (and stand-in badge).

tokens.name: gas-n2
tokens.usage: Nitrogen stand-in badge.

tokens.name: gas-n2-fill
tokens.usage: Nitrogen tank fill: cool and dark, to separate it from CO2.

tokens.name: gas-co2
tokens.usage: Carbon dioxide stand-in badge.

tokens.name: gas-co2-fill
tokens.usage: Carbon dioxide tank fill: warm and lighter, to separate it from N2.

tokens.name: gas-h2
tokens.usage: Hydrogen stand-in badge, left half.

tokens.name: gas-h2-alt
tokens.usage: Hydrogen stand-in badge, right half.

tokens.name: gas-h2-fill
tokens.usage: Hydrogen tank fill: a deeper red than CH4.

tokens.name: gas-ch4
tokens.usage: Methane stand-in badge.

tokens.name: gas-ch4-fill
tokens.usage: Methane tank fill: lighter than H2.

tokens.name: gas-n2o
tokens.usage: Nitrous oxide tank fill (and stand-in badge).

tokens.name: gas-x
tokens.usage: Pollutant tank fill (and stand-in badge).

tokens.name: gas-o3
tokens.usage: Ozone stand-in badge.

tokens.name: gas-o3-fill
tokens.usage: Ozone tank fill.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Barlow Condensed. Always uppercase except hero and badge.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The one headline figure of a screen. The unit beside it is 64px in text-muted.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: Screen name inside the header banner. Uppercase.

styles.name: clock
styles.usage: Clock at the right of the header banner.

styles.name: chip-label
styles.usage: Alert chips: OK, WARN, CRIT. Uppercase.

styles.name: badge-label
styles.usage: Symbol inside a stand-in gas badge. The only style under 24px; in game the game's icon replaces it.

groups.name: Body
groups.note: Barlow with tabular figures. Sentence case.

styles.name: value-lg
styles.usage: The first reading of a row.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Row names, tile readings, status words, counts.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: The second reading of a row, in text-secondary.

styles.name: unit
styles.usage: Units and column headings in text-muted. The floor: nothing is set smaller.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inset between a bar's track and its fill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between rows in a panel.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles, columns, buttons, and a light and its label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding. Row padding, left and right. Gap between a chip and its message.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Header banner and button padding, left and right.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Screen margin.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Fills inside bars, cells and tanks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Bars, cells, chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Rows, tiles, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the tank outline.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: The header banner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status lights.

shadow.note: Panels are sunk, text is lifted, lights glow. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: well-inset
tokens.usage: Inner shadow that sinks a panel into the screen.

tokens.name: text-drop
tokens.usage: Drop shadow under light text, as a text-shadow. Not on chip labels.

tokens.name: glow-ok
tokens.usage: Glow of an ok status light.

tokens.name: glow-warn
tokens.usage: Glow of a warn status light.

tokens.name: glow-crit
tokens.usage: Glow of a crit status light.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Selected or focused control: a solid orange outline, like the header banner's.

size.note: Fixed sizes on the 480 px per console cell canvas.

tokens.name: size-cell
tokens.usage: One console cell. A 2x2 screen is 960 by 960, a 3x1 is 1440 by 480.

tokens.name: size-header
tokens.usage: Header banner height.

tokens.name: size-light
tokens.usage: Status light diameter.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: Horizontal bar height.

tokens.name: size-cell-bar
tokens.usage: Vertical cell bar height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum readout row height.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Minimum button height.
